site.title: {project} - Tuaritanga Kōnae Whakawehe
site.description: {project} he pūmanawa tuaritanga kōnae peer-to-peer i hangaia ki runga i ngā hangarau hou whakawehe.
site.ogDescription: Tuaritanga kōnae peer-to-peer i hangaia ki runga i ngā hangarau hou whakawehe. Kāore he tūmau pokapū. Kāore he wāhi kotahi mō te hē.

hero.subtitle: Te whakatupuranga e haere mai ana o te tuaritanga kōnae peer-to-peer
hero.description: I hangaia ki runga i ngā hangarau hou whakawehe. Kāore he tūmau pokapū. Kāore he wāhi kotahi mō te hē.

about.title: Mō
about.intro: {project} he pae tuaritanga kōnae peer-to-peer mō te whakatupuranga e haere mai ana, i hangaia ki runga i ngā hangarau hou whakawehe. Ka whakakotahi i te atanga kaiwhakamahi māmā me te hanganga whakawehe katoa, e whakarato ana i te otinga haumaru me te pono mō te tuaritanga raraunga, motuhake i tētahi mana pokapū. He matapuna tuwhera te kaupapa, ka tohaina i raro i te {license}.

decentralized.title: Whatunga whakawehe katoa
decentralized.description: Kāore he tūmau pokapū, kāore he wāhi kotahi mō te hē. Ka rapu, ka tikiake ngā kaiwhakamahi i ngā tuhinga tika i waenga i a rātou anō, kāore e whakawhirinaki ki ngā kaiwhakahaere pokapū, kaiaroturuki, papaaweto rānei.

accessControl.title: Mana whakauru taipitopito
accessControl.description: Kua wātea ia tangata ki te tīmata i tōna ake whatunga me āna ake ture. Tautuhia ngā tūranga kaiwhakamahi i roto i ia whatunga: kaipupuri, kaiwhakahaere, kaiwhakaputa, kaiarataki me ngā kaitikiake. Whakahaerea tika ko wai ka taea te whakaputa, te whakahaere, te tikiake i ngā tuhinga.

ui.title: Atanga kaiwhakamahi tino pai
ui.description: He atanga pokapū pāpāho mā me te ngāwari, i hoahoatia mō ngā pae papamahi, pouaka whakaata me te pūkoro. Whakatere māmā me te papapātuhi, kiore, gamepad, whakahaere mamao rānei. Ka taea e ngā kaiwhakamahi mōhio te whakamahi i te atanga raina whakahau hei whakahaere i te pūmanawa hei tūmau kōnae kāhore he māhunga.

dataFormat.title: Hōputu raraunga ka taea te pānui e te tangata
dataFormat.description: Ko te hōputu raraunga LISH e ahu mai ana i te JSON, e ngāwari ana ki te hanga, ki te pānui me te mārama. Tohaina āu tuhinga me ngā raraunga mata mārama, mārama ka taea e te tangata te tirotiro.

security.title: Tūmataitinga me te haumarutanga
security.description: Ka whakamuna te whakawhitiwhiti peer-to-peer katoa, e whakaū ana ka noho tūmataiti tāu raraunga i te wā o te whakawhiti. Ka taea e ngā kaiwhakamahi te huna ki muri o te VPN mō tētahi paparanga muna anō. Ka whakamana {project} i tō tūmataitinga mā te hoahoa.

crossPlatform.title: Whakawhiti pae
crossPlatform.description: Kei te wātea te pūmanawa mō ngā pae Windows, Linux me macOS. Whakamahia ki tētahi taputapu e hiahia ana koe.

download.title: Tikiake
download.description: Whiwhi ki te {project} mō tō pae. He kore utu, he matapuna tuwhera ngā tikiake katoa.

macos.title: Pānui nui mō ngā kaiwhakamahi macOS:
macos.intro: Ka aukati a macOS Gatekeeper i ngā taupānga kāore i hainatia / kāore i whakamanahia i tikiake mai i te ipurangi me te hapa {error}.
macos.error: "kua pakaru, kāore e taea te whakatuwhera"

macos.explanation: Ka tangohia tēnei i te āhuatanga taratahi, ka tukuna te taupānga kia rere.
